subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs and its timeout/fence semantics as the canonical fix for deferred turn-maintenance stalls in #96703?
rationale: The code path is plausible, but root policy sets a high bar for new config/env surfaces and this change intentionally alters same-session maintenance recovery behavior when configured.

options.title: Accept opt-in timeout/fence
options.body: Land this branch as the canonical fix with the timeout disabled by default and document #100103 as superseded or retargeted.

options.title: Require no-new-config policy
options.body: Ask for a revision that uses existing session recovery or a maintainer-owned default policy instead of adding another compaction config key.

options.title: Defer to another recovery design
options.body: Keep this PR paused or close it if maintainers prefer #100103 or a different core recovery design as the canonical path.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in timeout/fence
recommendation.body: Land this branch as the canonical fix with the timeout disabled by default and document #100103 as superseded or retargeted.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original background turn-maintenance feature and are the strongest owner signal for accepting changes to that scheduler/config boundary.
